scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test -w desktop
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:desktop && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux dir --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.verify: npm run check:db-safety && npm run typecheck && npm run test -w web && npm run test -w desktop && npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run check:artifacts
